newsitem.title: USA: NICOR agrees to join Viking project.
newsitem.headline: NICOR agrees to join Viking project.

text.p: NICOR Inc said Tuesday it agreed to a letter of intent to join the Viking Voyageur Gas Transmission project, a $1 billion pipeline, as a 20 percent partner.

NICOR joins Calgary-based TransCanada PipeLines Ltd and Minneapolis-based Northern States Power Co as sponsors of the project. NICOR said it will continue to work toward a definitive agreement to become a 20 percent partner.
The Viking Voyageur project is a proposed 800-mile pipeline designed to transport natural gas from the Canadian border to the U.S. Midwest.
The companies plan to seek regulatory and other approvals this fall, with operations to begin by late 1999. The initial capacity of the pipeline will be 1.2 bilion cubic feet of natural gas per day.
NICOR is a holding company with Northern Illinois Gas and Tropical Shipping as its principal businesses.
